id: \bPokémon stat enhancers can be bought only here.
en: \bPokémon stat enhancers can be bought only here.
it: \bI potenziatori delle statistiche dei Pokémon si possono comprare solo qui.

id: \bHP Up increases the base HP of a Pokémon.
en: \bHP Up increases the base HP of a Pokémon.
it: \bIl PS-Su aumenta i PS base di un Pokémon.

id: \bCalcium increases the base Sp. Atk of a Pokémon.
en: \bCalcium increases the base Sp. Atk of a Pokémon.

id: \bZinc increases the base Sp. Def of a Pokémon.
en: \bZinc increases the base Sp. Def of a Pokémon.
it: \bLo Zinco aumenta la Difesa Speciale di base di un Pokémon.

en: \bCarbos increases the base Speed of a Pokémon.
it: \bIl Carburante aumenta la Velocità base di un Pokémon.
